# v1.1.0-dev.87 — A control that says when your displays disagree

Pre-release off the `dev` branch. Builds on `v1.1.0-dev.86`.

## "Multiple Values" On The Control Itself

dev.86 gave several selected monitors one shared set of controls. When
those displays were already at different values it told you so, but only in
the small readout beside each control. The control itself still said
**Leave unchanged**.

That was two answers to the same question. There is no single current value
to leave when two displays are at different scales. The control now says it
where you are looking:

> Multiple values — leave each as it is

Scaling, Resolution and Orientation all say it the same way. Leaving that
option alone leaves each display exactly as it is. Picking anything else
applies it to all of them.

When the selected displays do agree, the control reads **Leave unchanged**
as before, because then there really is one value to leave.

## Install

Auto-updates from dev.53 and later. Otherwise unzip and run.
